text.p: National TechTeam Inc said it has completed the purchase of the remaining shares of WebCentric Communications Inc of Omaha, Neb.

TechTeam's original investment of $775,000 in cash was made in September 1996 for 15 percent of WebCentric's shares. Acquisition of the remaining 85 percent was for a combination of National TechTeam common stock and cash totaling $6,149,000, bringing the total cost to $6.9 million.

WebCentric develops Internet-initiated teleconferencing and call completion services. National TechTeam provides information technology outsourcing to large national and multi-national corporations, government agencies and service organizations.
